candidate.init: reconstructed p4.1 arm B encoder, verified against the published dose signature

p4_1.reconstruction_rule: rebuild arm B from the frozen runner; accept only if all three published dose signatures reproduce exactly

scaffold_role: training-only 4-way head on the read context; never at evaluation
frozen_scope: every parameter not listed in emission_parameters, including the whole rgb encoder, binding, native recurrence and decoders
gradient_scope: prepared states and per-byte state evolution are constants; the byte loss trains only the emission read of those constants
observation_rule: same packet, same pixel values: rgb patches [16,48] regrouped to columns [16,48] with column coordinates; audio and proprio unchanged

criteria.response_round: exact answer bytes plus EOS plus valid UTF-8, greedy, 65-byte cap
criteria.main_denominator: all 32 fit rounds; a failed or extra-byte round is counted, never deleted or filtered
criteria.correction_protocol: first pass on fit; for every first-pass error release the correct answer and take 8 Adam updates at the feedback lr; re-ask the same input once
criteria.control_arm: same trained subject, same feedback exposure, zero parameter updates and zero state writes
criteria.feedback_gain: learned second-pass fit accuracy minus control second-pass fit accuracy
criteria.recovery: save the trained bundle, reload in an independent process, re-ask all 32; outputs must be byte-identical
criteria.not_identifiable_rule: if first-pass fit errors are below 4, correction and feedback gain are recorded as not_identifiable_by_design, not as passes or failures
criteria.scaffold_early_stop: stop stage 1 at a dose when train and fit scaffold accuracy are both >= 0.95; stop at the second dose when fit scaffold accuracy is <= 0.35 at both doses
criteria.a_retention: not_applicable_no_A_parent; no accepted A parent exists, so no A suite exists to retain
criteria.check2: not_read; no check suite exists and no check budget is consumed
criteria.parent_candidate: main gate plus correction and feedback gain plus recovery, on development fit only

stop_conditions.budget: cpu_cap or wall_cap reached -> budget_stop, keep every checkpoint and report the last dose
stop_conditions.reconstruction: any signature mismatch -> p4_1_reconstruction_mismatch, stop before stage 1
stop_conditions.scaffold: train and fit both >= 0.95 -> stop stage 1 and enter stage 2; fit <= 0.35 at the first two doses -> scaffold_cannot_read_answer and stage 2 still runs once for the comparable reading
stop_conditions.engineering: non-finite gradient or parameter, missing checkpoint, cache replay mismatch, or source pin mismatch -> engineering_failure

price_measured.note: two price runs: an idle-machine run measured 0.28125 per scaffold step, a loaded-machine run measured 0.421875; the cap adopts the slower run as an upper bound, so a fast run finishes well below it

authorization.asked: 是否授权执行 22.5.P4.2 两阶段字节路径卡（重建 P4.1 B 臂 + 读取脚手架 7376 步 + 字节头 1844 步 + 纠正/恢复，实测帽 3960 CPU／7920 wall）
authorization.scope: development fit only; no check or final read; no capability claim; parent candidate only
authorization.note: contract frozen with a measured cap; the run is blocked until training_authority is filled by the owner

note: pre-registration and price frozen; the run needs owner authority; no optimizer step has been taken under this contract

implementation_facts.fact: a forward hook returned the captured tensor through dict.setdefault, and PyTorch treats a non-None hook return as the module output, so the 8-dim context was replaced by its 24-dim input
implementation_facts.fix: hooks return None explicitly; the affected price reading was discarded and the price re-measured

scoping_correction.claim: this card can produce a parent candidate on development fit, not an accepted learning parent
scoping_correction.why: 22.5.1 also requires A retention, a three-seed paired-world lower bound and check2; no accepted A parent exists, so A retention has no object, and no check suite or check budget is touched
